generationSteps.purpose: 保留人物身份，移除包及肩带
generationSteps.prompt: EDIT TARGET: the attached original full-body male traveler sprite from the game 榫间. Make a single production sprite, retaining the exact same recognisable Chinese male college-student character: clean neat short dark hair, the same mature youthful face and jaw, eye shape, natural proportions, gray-blue rolled-sleeve outdoor shirt-jacket over an off-white T shirt, dark trousers, hiking shoes, tan paper notebook in his right hand (on the viewer's left), and the same relaxed three-quarter pose and gaze towards screen right. Make only the indoor change: remove the entire olive hiking backpack behind his shoulders and torso, remove BOTH backpack shoulder straps, hanging webbing, buckles and all bag remnants. Where the straps used to cross the chest, reconstruct the original gray-blue jacket folds, seams and front pockets naturally. Do not change the face, hairstyle, head angle, expression, clothing identity, hand anatomy, notebook, stance or the framing. Keep him fully contained head to shoes, same 2:3 portrait proportions as the input, generous transparent margin, crisp clean hard-edged anime illustration with clear cel-shaded planes matching the original; no soft chibi/cartoon redesign. Genuinely transparent background (alpha), NO dark halo, no colored background, no ground, no vignette, no cast shadow outside the figure. This is the same man after setting down his hiking bag inside the house. No words, no logos.

generationSteps.purpose: 透明边缘清理复核，不改变人物
generationSteps.prompt: Clean up ONLY the alpha/background of this exact character sprite. The approved character and all visible artwork within his silhouette MUST remain identical: exact face, hair, head angle, jacket, white T shirt, paper notebook, hands, trousers, shoes, pose and size. Keep the indoor no-backpack condition: no backpack or shoulder straps. Remove EVERY trace of the black/gray/brown soft vignette, glow and background shadow around him, including the large dark gradient on the left, right, behind his legs and underneath the shoes. Output a clean game sprite cutout on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA background; pixels outside the hair/clothing/hand/shoe silhouette must be fully transparent, not dark translucent. Only natural narrow anti-aliasing at the silhouette edge. No colored matte, no gradient, no soft halo, no drop shadow, no ground contact shadow. The opaque character should remain solid, not translucent. Keep the whole figure within the same 1024x1536 / 2:3 canvas with the same margins. This is an alpha cleanup task, not an illustration redesign.

generationSteps.purpose: 同构图门前送别与两个人物
generationSteps.prompt: Create one coherent 16:9 production game background EDIT of reference image 1, the existing daytime village entrance illustration for 榫间. Keep the SAME fixed camera, house placement, doorway on the upper left, stone steps descending from that doorway, downhill village road, rain shelter on the right, mountain terraces, power lines and vegetation. Preserve the house and steps geometry, the quiet morning-after-rain palette, warm natural sunlight, wet paving and reflections. This scene is a modest farewell the morning after the visitor repaired the village bench. Add exactly TWO fully painted figures integrated into this scene, not separate pasted portrait cutouts: (1) Zhou Bo, the SAME elderly Chinese retired carpenter in reference image 2, gray swept short hair, angular but kind mature face, washed gray-blue plain work jacket over ordinary gray undershirt, dark trousers and dark cloth shoes. He stands naturally at his open doorway on the top stone landing, about the size implied by the doorway, smiling gently and giving a small relaxed farewell gesture. His feet must rest visibly on the landing and his soft contact/cast shadows must follow the existing sunlight. (2) Xiaoxu, the SAME young Chinese woman from reference image 3, chestnut short ponytail, dusty rust-orange hiking shell, cream shirt, dark hiking trousers and hiking shoes, small dark teal backpack. She is a few steps downhill from the landing, near the left-middle road, turned slightly back toward Zhou and the first-person viewer as if waiting to leave together. Natural adult proportions, modest friendly expression, both feet planted on appropriate stone levels with accurate contact shadows. The figures should remain environmental scale (roughly 25 to 35 percent of canvas height), not huge foreground cutouts, and should not hide the doorway or the road. The protagonist is the first-person viewer and MUST NOT be drawn in this background: no third person, no duplicate male student, no visible player hands or body. Render background and people as ONE image with unified hard-edged anime line weight, grouped cel-shaded planes and natural material detail, matching the already established game rather than photographic figures or soft chibi. Preserve all major objects from image 1, the road and foreground remain free for UI overlays. Add no text, signs, subtitles, logos, UI, symbols or new buildings. This is an original contemporary Chinese mountain village, not an ancient costume setting.

generationSteps.purpose: 修复前景雨棚无已修长凳的连续性
generationSteps.prompt: EDIT TARGET is reference image 1, the farewell scene outside Zhou Bo's house. Make exactly one small continuity correction: the village long wooden bench repaired earlier in the story should now be visible inside the rain shelter on the RIGHT side of the road. Use reference image 2 only as a design reference for the finished long bench: warm brown substantial timber, two sturdy end trestles, full wide wooden seat, lower cross rail and visible joinery. Paint a single completed bench at the correct distant scale under the right shelter roof, behind the nearer pillars, grounded on that shelter's paved landing with correct perspective and soft contact shadow. The bench should fit naturally between shelter posts parallel to its side, not project into the road, and remain much smaller than the foreground woman. Keep the foreground stone posts as part of the shelter construction; do not create a second bench or floating seat. Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE in the first image exactly: the two people, faces, clothing, gestures, backpacks, house doorway, stairs, foliage, mountains, electric wires, the wet road, camera angle, cropping and colors. In particular keep the kindly elderly man at the left doorway, the orange-jacketed young woman near the steps, and no male protagonist drawn in the scene. Do not copy the man from reference 2, do not add any extra person. Same clean hard-edged anime style and integrated natural morning light. No text, UI or logos.

assets.prompt: Create a new 16:9 wide game background, 1920x1080 design, for the modern Chinese narrative game 榫间. Reference image 1 is ONLY the established anime illustration style, clear decisive contours, grouped light/shadow planes, believable material textures, quiet natural daylight; DO NOT copy its village workshop, tools, elderly character or furniture. NEW SCENE: the clean ordinary study corner of a Chinese male college student's family home on his first weekend back from a hiking trip. No people or body parts are visible: first-person viewer. A simple contemporary pale wood writing desk occupies the foreground/lower middle. On the desk, naturally placed and clearly readable as objects, lie a tan small paper travel notebook opened to blank/sketchy pages, a slim three-panel blue-gray event leaflet unfolded with only abstract graphic blocks and small non-legible lines (NO actual text/letters/numbers), a mechanical pencil, and a plain ceramic mug. A small closed laptop sits at the far edge; a modest desk lamp is off in daylight. Window to the side reveals soft leafy trees and distant ordinary contemporary residential buildings, NOT the mountain village. Simple off-white walls, a small bookcase with a few textbooks/binders without readable spines, understated gray-blue curtains, a chair partly tucked under the desk, and a small potted plant. Adult student space, tidy and lived-in, simple and approachable, neither luxurious nor childish. Natural late morning window light lays soft-edged shadows across the desktop; a quiet fresh, slightly warm neutral atmosphere. Keep a broad uncluttered patch of desktop for UI and narrative, and the far left quarter relatively simple for a dialogue portrait overlay. Camera is a stationary first-person medium-wide view at natural seated/standing viewing height, not an overhead flat lay. All objects belong to one coherent painting and share correct scale, perspective, contact shadows and line weight. No carpentry bench, no tool wall, no chisels or saws, no timber stocks, no school classroom, no old man, no girl, no protagonist figure, no photographs, no 3D low-poly look, no chibi, no UI, no decorative captions or logo. The notebook and leaflet link this ordinary home to the travel story and the upcoming beginner woodworking exchange contest, but the visual must remain an ordinary student home study.
